system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show a successful interactive logon for ben.carter on WS-BCARTER-01 at 13:59:49 UTC, followed by userinit.exe and explorer.exe starting under that user's logon session.
That session launched PowerShell to call an internal Harbor Dental API endpoint; the records show the command and process ancestry but do not show the request's result.
The session later launched Firefox to graph.microsoft.com, and the proxy recorded a successful tunnel to that host; Outlook also launched in the same user session.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include the alleged repeated failed logons around 13:40 UTC. They include a WS-BCARTER-01 event at 13:22:58 and then resume at 13:59:49; there is no supplied record for the intervening period.
No domain-controller authentication records are supplied, so the failure status, source host or address, and authentication method for the alert cannot be verified.
The available workstation records after 13:59 show process starts and network-related activity, but do not establish who initiated the earlier failed attempts or why they occurred.
claims_not_established: That ben.carter, rather than another host, process, or actor, caused the reported failed logons.
That the failed attempts were malicious, or that they were caused by a benign mistake such as stale credentials.
Whether the successful 13:59 interactive logon was related to the reported failures.
additional_evidence_needed: Domain-controller Security logs for 13:20–14:20 UTC on 2026-10-20, especially failed and successful authentication events for ben.carter, including source workstation/address and logon type.
Account lockout, password-change, and authentication-provider records for ben.carter covering the same interval.
WS-BCARTER-01 authentication and endpoint telemetry covering the missing 13:23–13:59 interval, plus corresponding logs from any identified source host.
